column2:
damp(adj./n./v.)潮濕的、濕氣、使潮濕
dampen(v.)使潮濕、使沮喪
dampness(n.)潮濕
damp weather 潮濕的天氣
damp cloth 濕布
Wipe the table with a damp cloth.
(用濕布擦桌子。)
The basement always feels damp in spring.
(地下室在春天總是感覺很潮濕。)

deadline(n.)截止期限
(無詞性變化)
meet a deadline 趕上截止期限
miss a deadline 錯過截止期限
The deadline for the report is next Friday.
(報告的截止日是下週五。)
I stayed up all night to meet the deadline.
(我熬夜一整晚來趕上截止期限。)

declare(v.)宣布、聲明、申報
declaration(n.)宣言、聲明、申報
declare war on 對⋯宣戰
declare goods 申報物品
The government declared a state of emergency after the earthquake.
(地震後政府宣布進入緊急狀態。)
Do you have anything to declare at customs?
(您在海關有任何物品要申報嗎？)

decoration(n.)裝飾、裝飾品
decorate(v.)裝飾
decorative(adj.)裝飾用的
Christmas decorations 聖誕裝飾
for decoration 作為裝飾
We put up Christmas decorations in the living room.
(我們在客廳掛上聖誕裝飾。)
The flowers on the table are just for decoration.
(桌上的花只是用來裝飾的。)

defeat(n./v.)擊敗、戰勝、失敗
(無詞性變化)
admit defeat 認輸
a narrow defeat 惜敗
Our team defeated the champions in the final.
(我們的隊伍在決賽中擊敗了衛冕冠軍。)
He refused to admit defeat even after losing three times.
(就算輸了三次，他仍拒絕認輸。)

defend(v.)防衛、保衛、為⋯辯護
defense(n.)防禦、辯護
defender(n.)防守者、辯護者
defend against 防禦⋯
defend oneself 為自己辯護、自衛
The soldiers fought bravely to defend their country.
(士兵們英勇作戰保衛國家。)
She stood up and defended her friend in front of the class.
(她在全班面前站出來為朋友辯護。)

defense(n.)防禦、保衛、辯護
defend(v.)防衛、辯護
defensive(adj.)防禦的、戒備的
national defense 國防
in defense of 為了保衛、為⋯辯護
Our team has a strong defense this season.
(我們隊這一季的防守很強。)
He spoke in defense of his classmate.
(他為同學辯護。)

defensible(adj.)可防禦的、可辯護的、站得住腳的
defend(v.)防衛、辯護
defensible position 易守的陣地、站得住腳的立場
morally defensible 道德上站得住腳的
Her decision to quit was perfectly defensible.
(她決定辭職是完全說得過去的。)
The castle was built on a hill to make it more defensible.
(這座城堡建在山丘上，讓它更易於防守。)

defensive(adj.)防禦的、戒備的、防衛心強的
defense(n.)防禦
defensively(adv.)防衛地
get defensive 變得有防衛心
defensive driving 防禦性駕駛
He gets defensive whenever someone criticizes his work.
(只要有人批評他的作品，他就會變得很防衛。)
The team changed to a more defensive strategy.
(這支隊伍改採更保守的防守策略。)

definite(adj.)明確的、確定的
definitely(adv.)一定、絕對
definition(n.)定義
definite answer 明確的答覆
definite article 定冠詞
I need a definite answer by tomorrow.
(我明天之前需要一個明確的答覆。)
I will definitely come to your birthday party.
(我一定會去你的生日派對。)

delicate(adj.)精緻的、脆弱的、微妙的、敏感的
delicacy(n.)佳餚、精緻、微妙
delicately(adv.)精巧地、小心地
delicate skin 細嫩的肌膚
delicate situation 微妙的處境
Handle the glass with care; it's very delicate.
(小心拿這個玻璃杯，它很易碎。)
Talking about money with friends can be a delicate matter.
(和朋友談錢可能是件敏感的事。)

delight(n./v.)欣喜、樂事、使高興
delighted(adj.)高興的
delightful(adj.)令人愉快的
to one's delight 令某人高興的是
take delight in 以⋯為樂
To my delight, I passed the driving test.
(令我高興的是，我通過了駕照考試。)
The magic show delighted the children.
(魔術表演讓孩子們非常開心。)

delightful(adj.)令人愉快的、討人喜歡的
delight(n./v.)欣喜、使高興
delightfully(adv.)令人愉快地
a delightful evening 愉快的夜晚
delightful surprise 令人驚喜的事
We spent a delightful afternoon by the lake.
(我們在湖邊度過了一個愉快的下午。)
Her grandmother is a delightful old lady.
(她的奶奶是一位討人喜歡的老太太。)

demand(n./v.)要求、需求、需要
demanding(adj.)要求高的、費力的
supply and demand 供給與需求
in demand 有需求的、搶手的
The workers demanded higher pay.
(工人們要求加薪。)
Good engineers are always in demand.
(優秀的工程師總是很搶手。)

demonstrate(v.)示範、證明、示威
demonstration(n.)示範、示威
demonstrator(n.)示威者、示範者
demonstrate how to 示範如何⋯
demonstrate against 示威反對⋯
The teacher demonstrated how to use the microscope.
(老師示範如何使用顯微鏡。)
The study demonstrates that exercise improves memory.
(這項研究證明運動能增進記憶力。)

demonstration(n.)示範、示威遊行、證明
demonstrate(v.)示範、示威
give a demonstration 進行示範
hold a demonstration 舉行示威
The salesman gave a demonstration of the new vacuum cleaner.
(推銷員示範了新款吸塵器的用法。)
Thousands of people joined the demonstration downtown.
(數千人參加了市中心的示威遊行。)

dense(adj.)密集的、濃密的、稠密的
density(n.)密度
densely(adv.)密集地
dense fog 濃霧
densely populated 人口稠密的
Flights were delayed because of the dense fog.
(班機因為濃霧而延誤。)
Taipei is one of the most densely populated cities in Asia.
(臺北是亞洲人口最稠密的城市之一。)

depart(v.)出發、離開
departure(n.)出發、離開
depart from 從⋯出發、背離
depart for 前往⋯
The train departs from Taipei Station at 8:30.
(火車在八點半從臺北車站出發。)
Our flight to Tokyo departs in two hours.
(我們飛往東京的班機兩小時後起飛。)

departure(n.)出發、離開、背離
depart(v.)出發、離開
departure time 出發時間
departure lounge 候機室
Please arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
(請在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。)
Her sudden departure surprised everyone in the office.
(她突然離職讓辦公室裡的每個人都很驚訝。)

dependent(adj./n.)依賴的、取決於⋯的、受撫養者
depend(v.)依賴、取決於
dependence(n.)依賴
be dependent on 依賴⋯
financially dependent 經濟上依賴的
Many teenagers are still financially dependent on their parents.
(許多青少年在經濟上仍依賴父母。)
Our plans are dependent on the weather.
(我們的計畫取決於天氣。)

depression(n.)沮喪、憂鬱症、經濟蕭條
depress(v.)使沮喪
depressed(adj.)沮喪的
suffer from depression 罹患憂鬱症
the Great Depression 經濟大蕭條
Talking to a doctor can help people with depression.
(和醫生談談可以幫助憂鬱症患者。)
Many people lost their jobs during the Great Depression.
(經濟大蕭條期間許多人失業。)

deserve(v.)應得、值得
deserved(adj.)應得的、理所當然的
deserve to 值得⋯、應該⋯
well deserved 實至名歸的
You worked hard, so you deserve a break.
(你很努力，所以你應該休息一下。)
Her award was well deserved.
(她得獎實至名歸。)

desperate(adj.)絕望的、拚命的、極需要的
desperately(adv.)拚命地、極度地
desperation(n.)絕望
be desperate for 極需要⋯
a desperate attempt 拚死一搏
After walking for hours, we were desperate for water.
(走了好幾個小時之後，我們極需要喝水。)
He made a desperate attempt to catch the last train.
(他拚命想趕上最後一班火車。)

despite(prep.)儘管、不管
(無詞性變化)
despite the fact that 儘管⋯的事實
despite oneself 不由自主地
Despite the heavy rain, the game continued.
(儘管下大雨，比賽仍繼續進行。)
She smiled despite herself when she saw the puppy.
(看到那隻小狗，她不由自主地笑了。)

destruction(n.)破壞、毀滅
destroy(v.)破壞
destructive(adj.)破壞性的
mass destruction 大規模毀滅
environmental destruction 環境破壞
The earthquake caused great destruction in the area.
(地震對該地區造成嚴重的破壞。)
We must stop the destruction of the rainforests.
(我們必須阻止雨林遭受破壞。)

detective(n./adj.)偵探、刑警、偵探的
detect(v.)察覺、偵測
detective story 偵探小說
private detective 私家偵探
Sherlock Holmes is the most famous detective in fiction.
(福爾摩斯是小說中最有名的偵探。)
I stayed up late reading a detective story.
(我熬夜看一本偵探小說。)

determination(n.)決心、堅定
determine(v.)決定
determined(adj.)下定決心的
with determination 堅決地
strong determination 堅定的決心
With great determination, she finished the marathon.
(她憑著堅定的決心跑完了馬拉松。)
His determination to succeed impressed everyone.
(他想要成功的決心讓大家印象深刻。)

device(n.)裝置、設備、手段
devise(v.)設計、發明
electronic device 電子裝置
safety device 安全裝置
Smartphones are the most common electronic devices today.
(智慧型手機是現今最常見的電子裝置。)
This device can measure your heart rate.
(這個裝置可以測量你的心跳。)

devise(v.)設計、想出、發明
device(n.)裝置、設備
devise a plan 想出計畫
devise a method 設計方法
The students devised a plan to reduce waste at school.
(學生們想出一個減少校園垃圾的計畫。)
Scientists devised a new way to clean the ocean.
(科學家設計出一種清理海洋的新方法。)

devote(v.)奉獻、致力於、把(時間、精力)用於
devoted(adj.)忠誠的、全心全意的
devotion(n.)奉獻、熱愛
devote oneself to 致力於⋯
devote time to 把時間花在⋯
She devoted her life to helping poor children.
(她一生致力於幫助貧窮的孩子。)
I devote two hours a day to practicing the piano.
(我每天花兩個小時練鋼琴。)

dew(n.)露水、露珠
dewy(adj.)帶露水的、濕潤的
morning dew 晨露
drops of dew 露珠
The grass was wet with morning dew.
(草地被晨露沾濕了。)
Drops of dew shone like diamonds in the sun.
(露珠在陽光下像鑽石般閃閃發亮。)

diagram(n./v.)圖解、圖表、用圖表示
diagrammatic(adj.)圖解的
draw a diagram 畫圖解
tree diagram 樹狀圖
The teacher drew a diagram to explain how the heart works.
(老師畫了一張圖來解釋心臟如何運作。)
Follow the diagram to put the desk together.
(依照圖解組裝書桌。)

differ(v.)不同、意見不合
difference(n.)差異
different(adj.)不同的
differ from 和⋯不同
differ in 在⋯方面不同
Customs differ from country to country.
(各國的習俗都不相同。)
The two brothers differ greatly in personality.
(這兩兄弟的個性差異很大。)

digest(n./v.)消化、理解、文摘
digestion(n.)消化
digestive(adj.)消化的
digest food 消化食物
digest information 消化(理解)資訊
Some people find it hard to digest milk.
(有些人很難消化牛奶。)
It took me a while to digest the bad news.
(我花了一段時間才消化這個壞消息。)

digital(adj.)數位的、數字的
digitally(adv.)數位地
digitize(v.)數位化
digital camera 數位相機
digital age 數位時代
In the digital age, information spreads very quickly.
(在數位時代，資訊傳播得非常快。)
She took the photos with a digital camera.
(她用數位相機拍了這些照片。)

dignity(n.)尊嚴、莊重
dignified(adj.)有尊嚴的、莊重的
human dignity 人性尊嚴
with dignity 有尊嚴地
Everyone should be treated with dignity.
(每個人都應該被有尊嚴地對待。)
She accepted the defeat with dignity.
(她很有風度地接受了失敗。)

diligence(n.)勤奮、用功
diligent(adj.)勤奮的
diligently(adv.)勤奮地
hard work and diligence 努力與勤奮
due diligence 盡職調查、應有的謹慎
Her diligence finally paid off when she got into a top university.
(她考上頂尖大學時，她的勤奮終於有了回報。)
Success comes from diligence, not luck.
(成功來自勤奮，而不是運氣。)

diligent(adj.)勤奮的、用功的
diligence(n.)勤奮
diligently(adv.)勤奮地
diligent student 用功的學生
be diligent in 在⋯方面勤奮
He is a diligent student who never misses a class.
(他是個從不缺課的用功學生。)
Be diligent in your studies, and you will see results.
(認真讀書，你就會看到成果。)

diploma(n.)畢業證書、文憑
(無詞性變化)
high school diploma 高中畢業證書
receive a diploma 領取畢業證書
She proudly received her diploma at the graduation ceremony.
(她在畢業典禮上驕傲地領取了畢業證書。)
A high school diploma is required for this job.
(這份工作需要高中畢業證書。)

diplomat(n.)外交官、有手腕的人
diplomatic(adj.)外交的、有手腕的
diplomacy(n.)外交、交際手腕
career diplomat 職業外交官
foreign diplomat 外國外交官
Her father is a diplomat who has lived in many countries.
(她的爸爸是一位外交官，曾住過許多國家。)
He is a real diplomat and never upsets anyone.
(他很會做人，從不得罪任何人。)

disability(n.)失能、身心障礙
disabled(adj.)身心障礙的
people with disabilities 身心障礙者
learning disability 學習障礙
The building is designed for people with disabilities.
(這棟建築是為身心障礙者設計的。)
Students with learning disabilities can get extra help.
(有學習障礙的學生可以得到額外的協助。)

disadvantage(n./v.)缺點、不利條件、使處於不利地位
disadvantaged(adj.)弱勢的、處境不利的
at a disadvantage 處於不利地位
advantages and disadvantages 優缺點
One disadvantage of living in the city is the noise.
(住在城市的一個缺點是噪音。)
Students without computers are at a disadvantage.
(沒有電腦的學生處於不利地位。)

disappoint(v.)使失望、disappointment(n.)失望、令人失望的人或事
disappointed(adj.)感到失望的
disappointing(adj.)令人失望的
to one's disappointment 令某人失望的是
be disappointed with 對⋯感到失望
I don't want to disappoint my parents.
(我不想讓我爸媽失望。)
To my disappointment, the concert was canceled.
(令我失望的是，演唱會取消了。)

disaster(n.)災難、徹底的失敗
disastrous(adj.)災難性的
natural disaster 天災
a complete disaster 一場徹底的失敗
Earthquakes and typhoons are common natural disasters in Taiwan.
(地震和颱風是臺灣常見的天災。)
Our first attempt at cooking was a complete disaster.
(我們第一次嘗試煮飯完全是一場災難。)

discipline(n./v.)紀律、訓練、學科、懲戒
disciplined(adj.)有紀律的
self-discipline 自律
academic discipline 學科
Self-discipline is the key to success.
(自律是成功的關鍵。)
The teacher disciplined the students for cheating.
(老師因為作弊懲處了那些學生。)

discourage(v.)使氣餒、勸阻、discouragement(n.)氣餒、勸阻
discouraged(adj.)氣餒的
discouraging(adj.)令人氣餒的
discourage someone from 勸阻某人不要⋯
feel discouraged 感到氣餒
Don't let one failure discourage you.
(不要讓一次的失敗使你氣餒。)
His parents discouraged him from riding a motorcycle.
(他的父母勸他不要騎機車。)

disguise(v./n.)偽裝、喬裝、掩飾
(無詞性變化)
in disguise 喬裝的、偽裝的
a blessing in disguise 因禍得福
The thief disguised himself as a delivery man.
(小偷喬裝成送貨員。)
Missing the bus was a blessing in disguise.
(錯過公車反而因禍得福。)

disgust(n./v.)厭惡、反感、使厭惡
disgusting(adj.)令人作嘔的
disgusted(adj.)感到厭惡的
in disgust 厭惡地
be disgusted by 對⋯感到厭惡
She looked at the dirty kitchen in disgust.
(她厭惡地看著髒亂的廚房。)
The smell of the garbage disgusted everyone.
(垃圾的臭味讓大家都很反感。)

dismiss(v.)解散、讓⋯離開、解僱、不予理會
dismissal(n.)解僱、解散
dismiss a class 下課、讓學生離開
dismiss an idea 不理會某個想法
The teacher dismissed the class ten minutes early.
(老師提早十分鐘下課。)
He dismissed my suggestion as unrealistic.
(他認為我的建議不切實際而不予理會。)

disorder(n./v.)混亂、失調、疾病、使混亂
disorderly(adj.)混亂的、無秩序的
in disorder 混亂地
eating disorder 飲食失調
After the party, the house was in complete disorder.
(派對結束後，房子一片混亂。)
Lack of sleep can lead to many health disorders.
(睡眠不足可能導致許多健康上的失調。)

dispute(n./v.)爭論、糾紛、對⋯提出異議
(無詞性變化)
in dispute 有爭議的
settle a dispute 解決爭端
The two countries are in a dispute over the island.
(兩國為了那座島發生爭端。)
No one can dispute the fact that she is talented.
(沒有人能否認她很有天分。)

distinct(adj.)不同的、明顯的、清楚的
distinction(n.)區別、卓越
distinctly(adv.)清楚地、明顯地
distinct from 與⋯不同
a distinct possibility 很有可能的事
The two languages are quite distinct from each other.
(這兩種語言彼此差異相當大。)
There is a distinct smell of smoke in the room.
(房間裡有一股明顯的煙味。)

distinguish(v.)區分、辨別、使傑出
distinguished(adj.)傑出的、著名的
distinguishable(adj.)可區分的
distinguish A from B 區分A和B
distinguish between 區分⋯
Can you distinguish right from wrong?
(你能分辨是非嗎？)
It is hard to distinguish between the twins.
(很難分辨這對雙胞胎。)

distinguished(adj.)傑出的、著名的、高貴的
distinguish(v.)區分、使傑出
distinguished guest 貴賓
distinguished career 傑出的職業生涯
We welcomed several distinguished guests to the ceremony.
(我們歡迎幾位貴賓蒞臨典禮。)
The professor had a distinguished career in science.
(這位教授在科學界有傑出的職業生涯。)

distribute(v.)分發、分配、散布
distribution(n.)分配、分布
distributor(n.)經銷商
distribute flyers 發傳單
evenly distributed 平均分布的
Volunteers distributed food to the flood victims.
(志工們分發食物給水災災民。)
The teacher distributed the test papers to the class.
(老師把考卷發給全班。)

distribution(n.)分配、分發、分布
distribute(v.)分發、分配
distributor(n.)經銷商
food distribution 糧食分配
the distribution of wealth 財富分配
The unfair distribution of wealth causes many social problems.
(財富分配不公造成許多社會問題。)
The map shows the distribution of rainfall in Taiwan.
(這張地圖顯示臺灣的雨量分布。)

district(n.)區域、地區、行政區
(無詞性變化)
school district 學區
shopping district 購物區
Xinyi District is famous for Taipei 101.
(信義區以臺北101聞名。)
They moved to a better school district.
(他們搬到了一個比較好的學區。)

disturb(v.)打擾、擾亂、使不安
